name: Chikara Chinen
career: Firmware QA engineer for smart kitchen appliances
bio: Chikara spends his workdays stress-testing carbonation sensors and app-connected drink machines, then goes home to experiment with no-added-sugar chocolate desserts in his small rental kitchen. He is loud, quick with jokes, and blunt enough that coworkers know not to ask for feedback unless they really want it. After dinner he follows beginner English and Linux troubleshooting videos, usually with funny cat clips open in another tab. He keeps his hair past his shoulders for amateur ballroom performances and, unexpectedly, restores dented vintage trumpet mouthpieces on weekends.
